Decision: Pay Per Ride/Minute  
**Justification**: The verified pay-per-use cost ($5.85) is significantly lower than the monthly membership ($29.00) for the 3 selected rides. Membership becomes cost-effective only for heavy users exceeding ~25 minutes monthly (based on $0.19/minute rate). For this scenario, pay-per-use is cheaper.  
**Breakdown**:  
- **Pay-per-use**: $5.85 (includes $1 unlock fee + $0.19/minute for 25+ minutes).  
- **Membership**: $29.00/month (includes 45 minutes; additional minutes at $0.17/minute).  
**Break-even**: ~25 minutes/month. Actual usage (3 rides) is well below this threshold.  
**Assumptions**: No duration data provided; usage is inferred from trip count. Always verify ride durations for precise cost comparisons.
